name: The tower top (a showcase for the testers, not a level of the game)
about: Javier & Claude, 2026-11-04. Level 10's boss from the team's roster, the Godfather of Glow, in three rounds: armour (only the Lovelight cuts his coat; don't throw it, he catches it), speed (only a blow into his wind-up lands), rage (he blocks the last combo used; two combos make him dizzy and the finisher then saves your love). Lose a life and only that round restarts. The Lovelight lies at the top of the stairs here (in the game it's found in level 9). Not in levels.json.
